Official final gamebook records New England 45, Las Vegas 17; 3,600 regulation seconds; both inactive lists, starters, substitutes, quarterback and specialist duty; and every printed injury/return sequence.

Official final report lists Jalen Nailor, Dont'e Thornton Jr. and Trey Zuhn III out; Thornton is marked IR-returned to practice; Ashton Jeanty is questionable and every other listed Raider has no final game status.
Official Week 5 depth chart lists Nailor with Benson behind him, Zuhn as the reserve right tackle, and the full active receiver and offensive-line candidate sets.

Postgame review records Cody White with 37 offensive snaps, Malik Benson with 16, Deven Thompkins with 13 and Dareke Young with 11 while Nailor and Thornton were absent. The gamebook identifies White as the starting receiver.
Contemporaneous report says Thornton was designated to return to practice but was not activated from injured reserve for Week 5.
Game-day report confirms Jeanty active, names Las Vegas' inactive list and identifies Aidan O'Connell as emergency quarterback.
Official final report binds every New England pregame injury status, including Gilliam, Hollins, Gonzalez, Davis, Prunty and Canada out.
Official roster analysis supplies the complete Week 5 secondary plan and reserve-list context for Gilliam and Hollins.
Official game-day analysis confirms the final inactive list, Gilliam unavailable and Corey Kiner as the active third running back.
Official film review identifies Tanner Arkin in Gilliam's fullback/H-back duty, Henderson's injury on the 11-yard jet sweep, and Caleb Lomu at left tackle for Campbell.
Published depth chart lists Dre'Mont Jones first and Gabe Jacas second at the same edge/OLB position and identifies Corey Kiner in the running-back chain.
Postgame review reports Woods and Durden returned, while Campbell, Henderson and Dre'Mont Jones did not return.

Postgame review confirms Kiner's increased work after Henderson, Arkin's added fullback duty, Lomu's left-tackle relief, Jones' no-return departure and heavy Jacas edge work. Snap counts establish role identity only, not exposure weights.
